lines.text: She called me out for being late.

data.define: To say publicly that someone did something wrong.

example.text: She called me out for being late.

misuse.text: Don't 'call out' a coworker in front of the boss.

data.l1_hook: Ela contou a todos o meu erro! ("call out")
data.l1_ex: Ela me chamou a atenção ("called me out") por estar atrasado.

native.tip: “call out” = expor; chamar a atenção; apontar. Exemplo: “She called me out for being late.”
